conversation.Statement: Good afternoon! This is Alan from Amazon Seller Performance. Am I speaking with Ms. Harper, the registered seller for account number ending 1742?
Yes, this is she. Is there a problem with my account?

Thank you for confirming. I'm reaching out because there's been a recent flag on your seller account related to possible policy inconsistencies. Before we proceed, can you please verify your business email and the last four digits of the phone number on file for security purposes?
Sure, my business email is harpergoods@gmail.com, and my phone ends in 2971.

Thank you, Ms. Harper. For your peace of mind, I want to assure you that our team is here to help you resolve this quickly. The issue appears to be a misunderstanding, but to proceed, I'll need to confirm your full legal business name as listed on your account.
It should be Harper's Home Essentials LLC.
Perfect, that matches our records. Now, the investigation notes mention a discrepancy in recent sales activity. Have you had any recent changes in your product listings or banking information?
No, nothing unusual. I just updated my address last week, but that's it.

Thank you for clarifying. It's possible that the address update triggered our automated review system. To ensure your account isn't restricted, we'll need to go through a brief re-verification process. This usually takes a few minutes.
Okay, what do I need to do?
First, I'll need you to log in to your Amazon Seller Central dashboard and confirm your account status. Are you able to do that now?
Yes, I'm logging in now.
Thank you. While you do that, I want to reassure you that this process is standard for seller protection. Now, do you see any notifications or messages on your dashboard?
It says 'Action Required: Account Under Review' at the top.
That matches our internal flag. To resolve this, Amazon requires a legal processing fee to be paid. This is a refundable charge that ensures compliance with our seller verification procedures.
I've never had to pay a fee like that before. Are you sure this is legitimate?

Absolutely, Ms. Harper. I understand your concern. This procedure is new as of last month to address increased account security. Once processed, your account status will be restored within two hours, and the fee will be reversed within five business days.
How much is the fee?
The processing fee is $395. For expedited handling, Amazon currently accepts payment via direct wire transfer or through Bitcoin. Which option would you prefer to use today?
I'm not sure how to use Bitcoin. Can I do a wire transfer instead?

Of course, wire transfer is perfectly acceptable. I'll provide you with our compliance department's banking details. Once you complete the transfer, please send a screenshot of the confirmation for our records. Does that sound alright?
Okay, I can do that. Should I use the business bank account I have on file with Amazon?
Yes, using your business account is preferred for verification. I'll read out the wire transfer details now. Please have a pen and paper ready.
I'm ready.
The bank name is 'First National Trust', account number 85339142, routing number 021000089. The account name is 'Amazon Seller Compliance'. Please enter the reference as your seller ID.
Got it. I'll do the transfer as soon as I finish this call.

Thank you, Ms. Harper. Once you've completed the transfer, kindly email the confirmation screenshot to amazon-verification@consultant.com. We'll prioritize your case and restore your seller privileges right away.
Alright, I'll send everything over. Is there anything else I should do?
That's all for now, but please don't hesitate to call this number if you have any questions. We truly appreciate your cooperation and want you to know your seller account is important to us.
Thank you for your help. I'll get this sorted right away.
You're most welcome. I'll keep an eye out for your confirmation. Thank you for being proactive, Ms. Harper, and have a wonderful day.
